rules.comparison: fixed oldnet_boost forecasts checked by key,label,weightsinference,fullreport replay; oldanchorcontrol samepopulation
rules.model: frozen overnight_decision_study.fit_variant net_boost; original18features; no peerfeatures added
rules.origins: Jan1/Apr1/Jul1/Oct1 in2024,2025,2026; quarterly models may use earlier test-year outcomes alreadyknown
rules.policies: net>.10percent; joint net>.10percent AND calibratedprobability>=.55; fixed normalcost target
rules.population: exact previous temporalFOLDS testpopulation; same rows for bothwindows andfixedcontrols; unknownsretained
rules.purging: train/cal label_end strictlybefore theirend; forecasttime partitions outertest rows, no extra quarter-end purge
rules.quarter_baselines: eachquarter uses itsown past train/cal statistics; quarteraccounts diagnostic andNOT summed
rules.reuse: 2024-2026 already inspected; updating withinyear iscausal butnotnewindependentholdout; reserveunopened
rules.unknowns: missing entry/exit stays unknown; selected unknown poisons account subsequently; no inventedzero returns
rules.windows: exactly24or48calendar months ending3months before eachquarterorigin; preceding3months calibrate
